"""Predicate semantics: exact arithmetic, all/index/field, match, consts."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

def run_campaign(campaign):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(campaign).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

types = [
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "Str6", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 6},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "Pair", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["lo", "N8"], ["hi", "N8"]]},
    {"name": "Arr3", "kind": "array", "element": "N8", "size": 3},
    {"name": "Box", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["arr", "Arr3"], ["p", "Pair"], ["flag", "B"]]},
]

def check(name, requires, objs_list, expect):
    mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["s", "Str6"], ["b", "Box"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
           "requires": requires}
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
                "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(objs_list))}]}
    out = run_campaign(campaign)
    got = out['records'][0]['status']
    assert got == expect, (name, got, expect, out)

def objs(sv, arrv, lo, hi, flagv, rv):
    seq = [("x%d" % (1 + i), le(sv[i], 1)) for i in range(6)]
    seq += [("x%d" % (9 + i), le(arrv[i], 1)) for i in range(3)]
    seq += [("x13", le(lo, 1)), ("x14", le(hi, 1)), ("x15", le(flagv, 1)), ("x16", le(rv, 1))]
    return seq

def ms(s):
    return [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(6, '\x00')]

A = [3, 255, 7]

# 1. add modulo: 255 + 5 == 4 (mod 256)
check("add", ["eq", ["add", ["index", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"], 1], ["const", "N8", 5]],
               ["const", "N8", 4]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
# 2. sub modulo: 3 - 5 == 254
check("sub", ["eq", ["sub", ["index", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"], 0], ["const", "N8", 5]],
               ["const", "N8", 254]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
# 3. all over array
check("all", ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
               ["ge", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N8", 3]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), [3, 3, 3], 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
check("all-fail", ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
                    ["ge", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N8", 3]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), [3, 2, 3], 1, 2, 0, 1), "FILTERED")
# 4. binding shadowing: inner all shadows outer; sibling unaffected
check("shadow", ["and",
        ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
          ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
            ["ge", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N8", 3]]]],
        ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", True]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), [3, 2, 3], 1, 2, 1, 1), "FILTERED")
check("shadow2", ["and",
        ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
          ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"],
            ["ge", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N8", 3]]]],
        ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", True]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), [3, 3, 3], 1, 2, 1, 1), "READY")
# 5. match on recovered (NUL-truncated) string
check("match", ["match", ["var", "s"], "a(b|c)*"],
      objs(ms("a\x00bc"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
check("match-full", ["match", ["var", "s"], "abc"],
      objs(ms("a\x00bc"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "FILTERED")
# 6. const strings keep embedded NUL literally
check("const-nul", ["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "Str6", "a\u0000bc"]],
      objs(ms("a\x00bc"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "FILTERED")
check("const-nul2", ["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "Str6", "a"]],
      objs(ms("a\x00bc"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
# 7. deep struct equality via const object; bool eq
check("struct-eq", ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "p"],
                    ["const", "Pair", {"lo": 3, "hi": 255}]],
      objs(ms("hi"), [3, 255, 7], 3, 255, 0, 1), "READY")
check("bool-eq", ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", True]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 1, 1), "READY")
# 8. implies / or / not
check("implies-t", ["implies", ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", True]],
                    ["lt", ["field", ["field", ["var", "b"], "p"], "lo"], ["const", "N8", 5]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 1, 1), "READY")
check("implies-f", ["implies", ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", False]],
                    ["lt", ["field", ["field", ["var", "b"], "p"], "lo"], ["const", "N8", 5]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 1, 1), "READY")
check("implies-f2", ["implies", ["eq", ["field", ["var", "b"], "flag"], ["const", "B", True]],
                    ["lt", ["field", ["field", ["var", "b"], "p"], "lo"], ["const", "N8", 1]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 1, 1), "FILTERED")
check("not", ["not", ["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "Str6", "hi"]]],
      objs(ms("hi"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "FILTERED")
# 9. all over empty array is true; index bounds fixed
check("empty-all", ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"], ["const", "B", False]],
      objs(ms(""), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
# 10. char/enum via nested? skip. match classes/escapes
check("match-class", ["match", ["var", "s"], "[0-9a-f]*x?y" ] if False else ["match", ["var", "s"], "[0-9a-f]*[!-~]"],
      objs(ms("beef\x00s"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")
print("T6 OK")
